page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: etiam omnes Apostoli, paris interfesse[?] ἀξίας, ἐξουσίας, ἀλλήλοις ἰσόψυχοι[?]. Longè ta-men Paulo inferior Barnabas, ille autho-ritate, charismatis, functione, omnibus major. Quod verò attinet Veteres, dum Provincias inter Apostolos, ad orbis curam universi partiuntur, & Thomae Parthiam aut Indiam, Andreae Scytiam Eu-ropæam, Matthiae interiorem Æthio-piam, Judae Ægyptum &c. assignant, Barnabam in ea distributione praetereunt. Quin τῶν ἑβδομήκοντα[?], septuaginta discipu-lis, expresse Clemens Lib.11. Strom. Eu-sebius Hist.Eccles. Lib.i. Cap.xii. Epi-phanius Hæres.xx. contrà Herodianos, annumerant. Quod verò dicatur Aposto-lus, sit ratione suæ ad Gentes legationis, Paulo ipse associatus Apostolo. Voceque nonnihil laxiori, & nominis significatio-ne longius extensa, ut etiam Calvinus ad locum. Quomodo ἐπίσημοι ἐν Ἀποστόλοις[?], Junias & Andronicus, Rom.xvi.7. Quemadmodum Ἀπόστολοι Ἐκκλησιῶν[?], Titus aliique fratres & cooperarij Pauli, II. Co-rinth.viii.23. Prout etiam Veteres promiscuè

page.notes: Top left and scattered across the page are specks and stains, not text. Greek words are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; the accents and some letters of ἀξίας…ἰσόψυχοι, τῶν ἑβδομήκοντα, ἐπίσημοι and Ἀπόστολοι Ἐκκλησιῶν are uncertain. "interfesse" is uncertain. The running head's final letter is uncertain. Roman numerals (Lib.11., II.) are copied as they appear and may be lowercase in print.
